# simplevm_volumes (Data Source)

Lists the volumes visible to the API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplevm_volumes" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier of this data source.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The volumes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Volume name.
- `size` (Number) Volume size in GB.
- `status` (String) Volume status, for example `available` or `in-use`.
- `uuid` (String) Volume UUID.
- `vm_name` (String) Name of the VM the volume is attached to, empty if detached.
